source_info.name: CrRinko 的 FnOS 应用源
source_info.author: CrRinko
source_info.description: 个人 FnOS 应用源，提供 OpenCode V2、Hermes Agent 等应用。

opencode.desc: 开源 AI 编程代理，提供 Web UI 与 CLI。Web UI 默认用户名：opencode；密码没有固定默认值，首次启动时随机生成。SSH 登录 NAS 后以 root 权限执行 sudo cat /var/apps/opencode/etc/password 获取。本包基于上游 OpenCode V2.2.5 linux-amd64 构建，仅适用于 x86 设备。

en-US.desc: Open-source AI coding agent with a Web UI and CLI. Web UI username: opencode. There is no fixed default password; it is generated on first start. Run sudo cat /var/apps/opencode/etc/password as root on the NAS to read it. Built from upstream OpenCode V2.2.5 linux-amd64 for x86 devices only.

2.2.5.changelog: r3：修复安装阶段 install_init 权限问题；密码改为首次启动时生成；开发者/发布者统一为 CrRinko。基于 OpenCode V2.2.5 linux-amd64 构建，提供 Web UI 与 CLI。

en-US.changelog: r3: fixed install_init permissions, moved password creation to first start, and aligned maintainer/distributor metadata to CrRinko. Built from OpenCode V2.2.5 linux-amd64 with Web UI and CLI.

hermes-agent.desc: Hermes Agent 官方 AI Agent，提供官方 Web Dashboard。首次启动后用户名 hermes，密码随机生成。SSH 登录 NAS 后以 root 权限执行 sudo cat /var/apps/hermes-agent/etc/password 获取密码。首次安装约 10–20 分钟，仅支持 x86 设备。

en-US.desc: Official Hermes Agent AI assistant with its official web dashboard. Username: hermes. The password is generated on first start; run sudo cat /var/apps/hermes-agent/etc/password as root on the NAS to read it. First install takes about 10-20 minutes. x86 devices only.

0.22.5.changelog: 首发：基于上游 Hermes Agent v0.22.5，官方 dashboard，随机密码登录；FPK 内置源码，安装时创建 Python 3.14 运行时；内置更新由 FnDepot/应用中心接管。

en-US.changelog: Initial release based on upstream Hermes Agent v0.22.5 with the official dashboard, generated password login, bundled source, and an install-time Python 3.14 runtime. Updates are owned by FnDepot/App Center.
